---
name: Bug report (technical only)
about: Report a reproducible, code-related bug. Off-topic issues will be closed.
title: "[Bug] <brief summary>"
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

## What happened
What you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. Steps to reproduce if
they aren't obvious.

## Environment
Browser and OS, and how you're running it — `npm run dev`, `npm run dev:lan`,
`npm start`, or Docker. If it's a phone, say which and over what (HTTPS on the
LAN, a real certificate, a tunnel).

## Where it broke
Which part, as best you can tell: the page and its rendering, the microphone or
audio path, the call itself, or the proxy. "Connects but says nothing" and
"never connects" are different bugs.

## Logs (optional)
Only the relevant console errors, and the proxy's output if it printed anything.
